encoding: closed UTF-8 JSON object; canonical writer key order below; at most 65536 bytes

fields.email: 0..320 UTF-8 bytes; typed login draft, not a login attempt or credential
fields.rejoin: 0..193 UTF-8 bytes; opaque existing app_host_keep reference; restored through the existing core
fields.environment: 0..8192 UTF-8 bytes; opaque existing es_save text; restored through es_restore

rules: All four members are required; extra, duplicate and escaped member names refuse the whole record.
Values are complete UTF-8 without NUL. No authentication or execution authority comes from this record.
No tokens, passkey proofs, private keys, backup values, pending identity commands or conversation bodies belong here.
A malformed record is ignored without changing credentials, pairings, resident-service state or old settings.
The platform persists complete encoded bytes atomically with owner-only permissions and writes only when they change.
